The cached fit above carries no log-likelihood curves, so the few clusters we
want to look at are re-fit with `build_graph = TRUE`. Strata are selected by
the columns that define them, because stratum *labels* are assigned
positionally and so are not stable across a subset:

```{r}
#| label: refit-displayed-strata
stratum_ids <- ests_summary |>
  tibble::as_tibble() |>
  dplyr::select(sample_size, lambda.sim, cluster)

ests_first_five <- refit_strata(
  pop_data = sim_df,
  strata_ids = stratum_ids |> dplyr::slice(1:5),
  sr_params = sim_curve_params,
  noise_params = sim_noise_params,
  curve_strata_varnames = NULL,
  noise_strata_varnames = NULL,
  antigen_isos = antibodies,
  num_cores = 1
)
```

{{< slidebreak >}}

```{r}
#| label: fig-cluster-logliks
#| fig-cap: >
#|   Log-likelihood curves for the first five simulated clusters.
#| fig-height: 7
autoplot(ests_first_five, log_x = TRUE)
```
